metadata.title: Model Lifecycle Governance

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing the full lifecycle of AI models from creation through deployment, evolution, and retirement.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: AI/ML model development, versioning, deployment pipelines, evaluation systems, and retirement processes.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern defining how AI models are identified, approved, versioned, promoted, monitored, and decommissioned in a controlled and accountable manner.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Provides AI-specific threat context for model tampering, unauthorized modification, and capability drift across the model lifecycle.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats where AI model behavior changes over time without approval, review, or awareness, leading to ungoverned risk.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats arising from deploying, updating, or replacing models without appropriate validation, approval, or rollback capability.

metadata.remarks: Model Lifecycle Governance defines how AI models are managed as critical, evolving assets. This pattern ensures that model creation, modification, deployment, and retirement are deliberate, auditable, and aligned with intended use, safety expectations, and risk tolerance.

components.title: Model Registration and Versioning
components.description: Unique identification, versioning, and lineage tracking for AI models and derivatives.

implemented-requirements.remarks: All AI models and derivatives are registered with unique identifiers and version histories to support traceability and rollback.

components.title: Approval and Promotion Controls
components.description: Formal governance gates for promoting models across development, testing, and production environments.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Model promotion and deployment require documented approval, validation results, and alignment with intended use.

components.title: Model Retirement and Archival
components.description: Controlled decommissioning, archival, or replacement of AI models no longer approved for use.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Unsupported or deprecated AI models are formally retired, archived, or disabled to prevent unintended use.
